hero.subtitle: Sabiencia is a complete learning management system for online education — managers, teachers and students, each with a tailored experience. Explore the full product now: it runs on realistic demo data, with no signup and nothing to install.

roles.title: One platform, three tailored experiences
roles.subtitle: Access is enforced by role at the routing layer (RBAC). Each profile sees only what it needs — open any one in the live demo.

items.name: Manager / CEO
items.description: A consolidated view of the whole operation: enrollments, finance and academic indicators.
bullets: Announcements to everyone or specific classes

items.name: Teacher
items.description: A focused pedagogical workspace for the classes each teacher is assigned to.

items.name: Student
items.description: Everything a student needs to follow their course, all in one place.

features.title: A complete academic workflow
features.subtitle: From enrollment to certificate — the day-to-day of an online school, covered end to end.

items.title: Academic management
items.description: Students, teachers, courses, classes and subjects in a single, organized place.

items.title: Grades & attendance
items.description: Record grades and track attendance per class, with clear status for each student.

items.title: Materials & video lessons
items.description: Publish PDFs, links and YouTube-hosted video lessons for each subject.

items.title: Announcements
items.description: Send targeted messages — to everyone, a specific class, or a single role.

items.title: Financial control
items.description: Track tuition, due dates and overdue payments from the manager dashboard.

items.title: Reports & export
items.description: Operational and financial reports, exportable to PDF, Excel and CSV.

items.title: Global search
items.description: Find students, classes, materials and more instantly with Cmd/Ctrl + K.

items.title: Themes & languages
items.description: Light and dark themes plus a one-click English / Portuguese switch.

trust.title: Substance you can verify
trust.subtitle: No inflated numbers — just an honest look at how the platform is built.

items.title: Try before you adopt
items.description: The whole product runs on realistic mock data out of the box. Explore every role with zero setup and no account.

items.title: Backend-ready, your data
items.description: A mock-first data layer that swaps to Supabase (Auth, Postgres, Storage) when you connect it — your institution keeps its own data.

items.title: Secure by design
items.description: Real security lives in Supabase Row-Level Security. We are honest about it: client-side signatures only guard local UI state, never the database.

items.title: Tested & reliable
items.description: 478 automated tests (unit, integration and end-to-end) and a fully typed TypeScript codebase keep behavior predictable.

items.title: Accessible & international
items.description: Skip links, visible focus, reduced-motion and high-contrast support, with the interface available in English and Portuguese.

items.title: Fast by default
items.description: Each role area is lazy-loaded as its own bundle, and heavy export libraries load only when they are used.

contact.title: See Sabiencia working for your institution
contact.subtitle: Want a guided walkthrough, or to talk about bringing your school online? Reach out and we will get back to you quickly.
contact.demoHint: Prefer to look around first? Explore the live demo — no signup required.

footer.productDesc: A modern, role-based learning management platform for online education. Manage students, teachers, classes, grades, attendance, announcements and finance — all in one place.
footer.tagline: Portfolio project — a fully functional LMS you can explore today.

demo.subtitle: Explore the platform through its three access profiles
demo.chooseProfile: Choose a profile below to enter the matching environment
demo.aboutData: Realistic data: the environments are populated with a sample dataset — students, teachers, courses and classes — that mirrors a real academic operation.
demo.aboutNav: Full navigation: explore the sidebar and walk through each profile's flows freely.
demo.aboutResponsive: Fully responsive: resize the window to see the interface adapt to desktop, tablet and mobile.
demo.aboutMetrics: Dynamic metrics: averages, attendance and indicators are computed in real time from the data.
demo.builtWith: Built with React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS + shadcn/ui
